description: This file defines the FulfilledPromise class, which represents a promise that has already been fulfilled in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It implements methods for handling promise resolution, rejection, and chaining, specifically for fulfilled promises.

classes.name: FulfilledPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has already been fulfilled, providing methods to chain further actions and retrieve its value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a fulfilled promise with a given value, disallowing construction with a promise object.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Returns a new promise that executes the provided onFulfilled callback when the promise is fulfilled.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Provides an error handler callback that triggers if the promise is rejected; for a fulfilled promise, it simply delegates to then.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Returns the fulfilled value or null if unwrapped is false.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state of the promise, which should be 'fulfilled'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures that the promise's value cannot be changed if it matches the initial value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws an exception because a fulfilled promise cannot be rejected.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: A no-op method for cancelling, not applicable to fulfilled promises.
